# Draft:List of Golden Raspberry Awards ceremonies

The Golden Raspberry Awards ceremonies are to recognize the worst the film industry had to offer of that year. Co-founded by American publicist John J. B. Wilson. It was created after Wilson went to see a 99-cent double feature of ''Can't Stop the Music and Xanadu'' and thought on his drive home that those movies deserved awards for their low quality.
The first ceremony was were held on March 31, 1981, at Wilson's living room alcove. The following year during a potluck party held at his home in Hollywood on the night of the 53rd Academy Awards, Wilson passed ballots regarding the worst in film to the attendees, and invited his friends to give random award presentations in his living room. By the 4th Golden Raspberry Awards ceremony, CNN and two major wire services covered the event. Wilson realized that by scheduling the Golden Raspberry Awards prior to the Academy Awards, the ceremony would get more press coverage.
There are 46 ceremonies listed below. This list is initially organized from oldest to newest. All ceremonies numbers are listed first, followed by date, Worst Picture, most awards, location, and host. This list is current as of the 45th Golden Raspberry Awards ceremony held on February 28, 2025.
